title: AanganCallExtraction
description: Fields extracted from one call. Use null when the caller didn't say. Never guess. The backend re-scores the lead from these facts (lib/policy.ts).

callback_phone.description: The number the caller asked to be called on, if they gave one (digits). null if they confirmed the number they're calling from.

area.description: Where the project site is (not where the caller lives), written in English letters even if the caller spoke Hindi or Marathi, e.g. 'Kothrud, Dahanukar Colony'.

room_count.description: Rooms in scope, counting the kitchen, when not a full home.

bhk.description: Homes only: 2BHK -> 2. null for offices or if not said.

scope.description: What they want done, in a few words, e.g. 'modular kitchen, wardrobes in 2 bedrooms, living room'.

intent.description: design_and_execution = they want the studio to design AND carry out the work (also when someone calls on behalf of the owners about a real project). exploring = no project planned yet ("just exploring", "early stage", "maybe later"). advice_only = wants ideas or a consultation without execution.

current_state.description: e.g. 'bare shell', 'builder flat, lived in 2 years', 'possession in 6 weeks'.

site_available_in_weeks.description: 0 if the site is available now.

deadline_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the project must be complete by, always on or after the call date. A month alone means the last day of its NEXT occurrence (said in October, 'March' = next March). Relative dates ('in 3 weeks', 'before Diwali') are resolved from the call date. null if no deadline was given.

budget_text.description: Only if the caller volunteered it, in their words.

budget_max_inr.description: Upper end of a volunteered budget in rupees (e.g. '10-12 lakh' -> 1200000).

decision_maker.description: self = owner/founder deciding; authorised = the decider has authorised them; research_only = checking on behalf of the owners, who will decide/attend; not_authorised = clearly cannot move forward.

source.description: How they heard of us. Keep referral names exactly.

promised_outcome.description: What the agent actually TOLD the caller would happen at the end of the call. 'none' if the call ended before a close.

escalate.description: Existing client who is upset or needs a senior person.

priority.description: Caller was let down before (no callback) or is a VIP referral.

open_questions.description: Questions the caller asked that the designer should answer.

score.description: The agent's own call. null for non-new-project calls.

summary.description: Three short lines for the designer: who and where; what and how big; timeline and anything to watch for.
